load_lvis_json: load a JSON file with LVIS instance annotations into dataset records for DensePose training
register_dataset: register a single LVIS DensePose dataset with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
register_datasets: register multiple LVIS DensePose datasets from an iterable of CocoDatasetInfo objects
load_lvis_annotations: load LVIS annotations from a JSON file and return an LVIS API instance
combine_images_with_annotations: combine image metadata and annotation dicts into structured dataset records with bounding boxes and keypoints
